field_notes.questionnaire: feeds the compatibility score; categories weighted evenly (values_lifestyle / interests / personality) per product decision
field_notes.gender_seeking: pre-filter, not part of the blended compatibility score — a mismatch here excludes the profile from the queue entirely and scores 0 if ever encountered

profiles.name: Maya Chen
profiles.self_description: Runs a small ceramics studio and will absolutely talk your ear off about glaze chemistry if you let her. Looking for someone who can go from a deep conversation about grief to a debate about the best breakfast taco within the same hour.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My hands — they're always covered in clay and I've made peace with that.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Effortless and earthy, thrifted linen over anything trendy.
physical_description.hair: Dark brown, usually in a messy bun
physical_description.signature_detail: Always has at least one ring made from her own studio.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: warm and a little chaotic in the best way

profiles.card_teaser: Will judge your kitchenware, gently.

profiles.name: Jordan Ellis
profiles.self_description: Product manager by day, amateur woodworker by night. Spent two years building a canoe in his garage and still isn't sure it floats. Wants someone who's genuinely curious about the world and won't mind a slightly sawdust-covered car.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My smile lines — my grandmother said I got them from laughing too much as a kid.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Classic and put-together, but always in boots.
physical_description.signature_detail: Wears the same flannel so often friends have started buying him new ones as a joke.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: steady, the friend everyone calls first with good news

profiles.card_teaser: The canoe floats. Mostly.

profiles.name: Priya Nair
profiles.self_description: ER nurse who processes a wild work week by baking absurdly ambitious desserts. Looking for someone low-drama, high-substance — someone who'll sit with her on the porch after a rough shift and not need it explained.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My eyebrows — they do a lot of the talking for me.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Comfortable and a little androgynous — oversized sweaters, good boots.
physical_description.signature_detail: Always smells like cardamom from whatever she baked that week.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: calm under pressure, quietly funny

interests.media_taste: Medical dramas (for the wrong reasons) and true crime

profiles.card_teaser: Has seen worse than your bad day. Bring dessert anyway.

profiles.name: Theo Brandt
profiles.self_description: Architect who spends most weekends restoring a very stubborn 1920s bungalow. Wants someone opinionated about design, unbothered by a little construction dust, and up for arguing about the merits of open floor plans.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My forearms, from years of drafting by hand and sanding old wood.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Clean lines, neutral tones, very intentional about everything he wears.
physical_description.signature_detail: Wears his late father's watch every day.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: quietly magnetic, the one people gravitate to at parties without knowing why

profiles.card_teaser: Will absolutely notice your crown molding.

profiles.name: Sofia Reyes
profiles.self_description: Second-year grad student studying marine biology, which means she has an alarming number of octopus facts on standby. Looking for someone kind, curious, and not intimidated by a woman with a five-year plan.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My freckles — I used to hate them, now they're my favorite thing about my face.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Colorful and a little eclectic, thrift-store treasures mixed with practical fieldwork gear.
physical_description.hair: Auburn, long and often in a braid
physical_description.signature_detail: Never without a tote bag full of books she's 'definitely going to finish.'
physical_description.energy_others_notice: bright and a little intense in the best way

profiles.card_teaser: Ask her about the mimic octopus. Just ask.

profiles.name: Marcus Webb
profiles.self_description: Divorced dad of two, restaurant owner, allergic to small talk. After a rough few years is finally ready to date again — looking for someone steady, funny, and unfazed by a Tuesday night that occasionally has to end at 9pm for bedtime logistics.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My laugh lines. Earned every one of them.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Casual and unfussy, chef whites more often than not, jeans and a good watch otherwise.
physical_description.hair: Salt and pepper, always a little unkempt
physical_description.signature_detail: Permanent flour dust somewhere on his clothes.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: grounded, the guy people trust immediately

profiles.card_teaser: Will cook for you unprompted. It's a whole thing.

profiles.name: Nina Kowalski
profiles.self_description: Freelance illustrator, plant parent to an unreasonable number of pothos. Looking for connection over labels — someone who's emotionally available, likes long walks and longer conversations, and doesn't need every plan pinned down in advance.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My tattoos — each one has a dumb story attached.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Eclectic, layered, somewhere between vintage and streetwear.
physical_description.hair: Bleached blonde, buzzed on one side
physical_description.signature_detail: Always has paint somewhere on their hands.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: a little mysterious until you get them talking about art, then unstoppable

values_lifestyle.relationship_intent: not sure yet, figuring it out

profiles.card_teaser: Owns 40 plants. Will not apologize for it.

profiles.name: Devon Park
profiles.self_description: Corporate lawyer trying to unlearn workaholism one badly-played guitar chord at a time. Looking for someone who'll call him out on working too much and drag him to a show instead.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My jawline, if I'm honest — I work out mostly so I can say that with confidence.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Polished and classic during the week, sneakers-and-hoodie on weekends.
physical_description.signature_detail: Always has AirPods in, even when talking to you.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: big presence, loud laugh, hard to miss in a room

interests.music_taste: Everything, but mostly hip-hop and blues
interests.media_taste: Legal dramas he yells at, stand-up specials

profiles.card_teaser: Objection: he's actually fun, I swear.

profiles.name: Elena Vasquez
profiles.self_description: High school teacher who genuinely loves her job, which either makes her a saint or a masochist depending who you ask. Wants someone patient, warm, and up for spontaneous weekend trips during the school breaks she counts down to.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My hands — I talk with them constantly, my students mock me for it.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Warm and put-together, bold color, statement earrings.
physical_description.hair: Dark brown with natural curls she's finally stopped straightening
physical_description.signature_detail: Always wears her late abuela's earrings.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: warm and approachable, the person strangers tell their life story to

profiles.card_teaser: Will teach you to dance badly, then well.

profiles.name: Sam O'Brien
profiles.self_description: Junior software engineer, competitive board gamer, aggressively mediocre at rock climbing but shows up every week anyway. Looking for someone who takes games (and very little else) seriously.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My eyebrows, unfairly expressive for someone who claims to have a great poker face.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Casual and comfortable, band tees and the same three hoodies on rotation.
physical_description.hair: Light brown, perpetually needs a haircut
physical_description.signature_detail: Wears mismatched socks on purpose, calls it a personality trait.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: easygoing, the friend who never makes things awkward

interests.music_taste: Video game soundtracks and indie rock

profiles.card_teaser: Will absolutely flip the board if he's losing. Kidding. Mostly.

profiles.name: Aisha Bello
profiles.self_description: Data analyst who spends her free time volunteering at a community garden and losing spectacularly at trivia night. Wants someone thoughtful, a little nerdy, and genuinely kind to strangers.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My smile — my dad always said I light up a room with it, and I've decided to believe him.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Minimalist and clean, monochrome outfits, always well put-together.
physical_description.signature_detail: Always has dirt under her nails from the garden.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: quietly steady, the one who remembers everyone's birthday

profiles.card_teaser: Will lose trivia gracefully. Will not let it go.

profiles.name: Ryan Tanaka
profiles.self_description: Physical therapist, marathon runner, recovering perfectionist. Looking for someone independent and warm who won't mind an alarm set for 5:30am on a Saturday.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My calves, from all the running — I've made peace with being that guy.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Athletic and functional, but cleans up well when it counts.
physical_description.signature_detail: Always wearing a running watch, even to dinner.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: calm and grounded, low-key competitive underneath it

profiles.card_teaser: Has a spreadsheet for his spreadsheets.

profiles.name: Claire Dubois
profiles.self_description: Recent grad working her first real job in publishing, still figuring out adulthood one grocery run at a time. Looking for someone patient with her chaos and up for cheap wine on a rooftop.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My eyes — they're a weird hazel-green that changes with what I'm wearing, or so I've been told.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Trendy and playful, always something a little unexpected.
physical_description.signature_detail: Always has chipped nail polish because she can never sit still long enough to let it dry.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: bright and a little scattered, in a charming way

values_lifestyle.relationship_intent: not sure yet, figuring it out

interests.music_taste: Pop and whatever's trending on playlists

profiles.card_teaser: Reads two books a week and remembers none of the plots.

profiles.name: Malik Johnson
profiles.self_description: High school basketball coach with strong opinions about zone defense and even stronger opinions about brunch. Looking for someone driven, funny, and willing to sit courtside on a Friday night.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My hands — good for both basketball and cooking, which covers most of what I love.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Sporty but sharp, always in good sneakers.
physical_description.signature_detail: Always has a whistle around his neck, even off the clock, out of habit.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: big presence, natural leader, warm underneath the bravado

profiles.card_teaser: Will coach you through your own life decisions, unsolicited.

profiles.name: Ingrid Larsen
profiles.self_description: Architect turned urban farmer after a mid-career pivot she has zero regrets about. Looking for someone secure, curious, and unbothered by the fact that her hands are permanently a little dirty now.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My hands, weathered from the work, and I actually love that about them now.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Practical and grounded, linen and denim, barely any jewelry.
physical_description.hair: Silver-streaked brown, long and often braided
physical_description.signature_detail: Wears the same wide-brimmed sun hat everywhere.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: grounded and calm, the person people go to for advice

profiles.card_teaser: Has bees. Will talk about the bees.

profiles.name: Tobias Kim
profiles.self_description: Bartender turned mixology instructor, plays bass in a band that's played approximately four real shows. Looking for someone who's up for late nights, doesn't mind his weird hours, and has genuinely good taste in music.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My arms, from carrying too many kegs — silver lining of the job.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Effortlessly cool, band tees under good jackets.
physical_description.hair: Black, longer and often tied back
physical_description.signature_detail: Always has a guitar pick somewhere in his pocket.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: chill and a little magnetic, the guy everyone ends up talking to at the bar

interests.music_taste: Everything on vinyl, mostly funk and soul

profiles.card_teaser: Will make you a drink you didn't know you wanted.

profiles.name: Freya Nilsson
profiles.self_description: Software developer by trade, aerial silks student by obsession. Looking for someone confident, kind, and unbothered by a schedule that occasionally involves hanging upside down from fabric three nights a week.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My shoulders — aerial work will do that, and I'm finally proud of it.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Sporty and androgynous, mostly athleisure with the occasional bold statement piece.
physical_description.signature_detail: Almost always has a bruise from silks class and zero regrets about it.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: quietly intense, warms up fast once comfortable

interests.media_taste: Sci-fi, circus and dance performance videos

profiles.card_teaser: Will casually mention she can do a full split. She can.

profiles.name: Diego Ramirez
profiles.self_description: Graphic designer and part-time DJ, spends most weekends either at a gallery opening or behind a mixer. Looking for someone creative, low-drama, and genuinely interested in Dallas' art scene.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My hands — covered in ink stains half the time from sketching.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Bold and fashion-forward, always in something a little unexpected.
physical_description.signature_detail: Rotates through statement glasses like other people rotate outfits.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: big presence, magnetic in a room, quieter one-on-one

profiles.card_teaser: Will DJ your birthday party whether you ask or not.

profiles.name: Hannah Park
profiles.self_description: Speech therapist who spends her weekends restoring vintage furniture she finds on the curb. Looking for someone genuine, a little handy, and up for a Saturday spent at estate sales.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My nose — a genuine Roman nose, family trait, three generations running.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Vintage-inspired, always in something with a story behind it.
physical_description.signature_detail: Always smells faintly of wood stain from her latest project.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: warm and understated, grows on you fast

profiles.card_teaser: Owns more sandpaper grits than is reasonable.

profiles.name: Owen Fitzgerald
profiles.self_description: Finance guy trying to prove he's more interesting than his job title. Actually a decent home cook and a serious fantasy football commissioner. Looking for someone sharp, funny, and not put off by a slightly too-competitive group chat.

physical_description.favorite_feature: My smile, according to my mom's incessant reminding me before every family photo.
physical_description.style_and_vibe: Clean and classic, quarter-zips and good sneakers.
physical_description.signature_detail: Always has his fantasy football app open, even at dinner.
physical_description.energy_others_notice: confident and a little competitive, warms up once he's comfortable

profiles.card_teaser: Will trade you a player for a second date. Kidding. Mostly.
